o: Set at an ancient castle set deep in the Scottish Highlands, everyday Americans work together on a series of exhilarating missions to build a prize fund worth up to $250,000. Hidden amongst the Faithful are the Traitors, whose goal is to eliminate the Faithful and claim the prize for themselves. Under the cover of darkness, the Traitors murder the Faithful one by one in a treacherous spree while…

eps.o: Alan Cumming opens the doors of his Scottish castle to 22 everyday Americans. The Traitors are chosen, the Faithful are under pressure and things get off to an explosive start.
Suspicion runs rife in the castle as accusations are thrown around and evidence is presented at a heated first roundtable; a life-or-death secret mission must be carried out in plain sight.

The Traitors are forced to make a difficult decision that could change the fate of the entire game; in a high-stakes mission, the players face a series of dilemmas and critical information that threatens to put the Traitors at risk.

Accusations fly and a Traitor battles to stay out of the spotlight; meanwhile, in a desperate bid to build the prize pot, the players are chased by a terrifying death parade and not everyone survives the night.
The Traitors try to commit murder in plain sight; a terrifying night lies ahead for the players.
Shaken by the funeral, the Faithful conspire to find out who committed the murder in plain sight.

eps.t: It's Like Fighting Two Pigs Under a Blanket
eps.o: The great fruit debate rages on as wild accusations tear through the castle and paranoia is at a fever pitch; new suspicions are aired, and an explosive mission gives one player the chance to win a game-changing power.

eps.t: A Bad Apple Spoils the Whole Bunch
The Sun, the Moon and the Truth
eps.o: With a place in the final on the line, the players must risk everything for a shot at victory; gambles are made at the roundtable and the Traitors face a mission where one wrong move could prove fatal.

Game-changing evidence comes to light at a critical roundtable, giving the players one last chance to identify a Traitor; an explosive daredevil mission could sway the prize pot, and a calculated murder leaves just six standing.

Lies are exposed and friendships unravel as a betrayal threatens to change the game; with the final five gathered at the fire of truth, Traitors and Faithful alike scramble to seize control in a desperate bid to claim the life-changing prize.
